### Talking and Weeping
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/talking-and-weeping
Passage: Genesis 45:9-15
Points:
- God's sovereign plans inevitably triumph over human schemes and advance His redemptive purposes.
- Even though God uses human actions for good, sin still produces genuine guilt and relational distress.
- Joseph's brothers struggled initially to accept his pardon because of the weight of their past betrayal.
- A key mark of spiritual growth is the genuine desire to see broken relationships healed.
- When forgiving others, believers must show patient sensitivity and avoid continually bringing up past offenses.

### Are You Going with the Gospel?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-november-10-2023.html
Passage: Genesis 45:9-13
Points:
- Joseph sending his brothers to share the news points to the Great Commission to proclaim Christ.
- The Christian life consists of coming to Jesus and then going out into the world.
- Like Joseph, Jesus was once rejected by His own but has been exalted by God over all.
- Joseph's desire to provide for his family illustrates Christ's gift of forgiveness and shared glory.
- Believers have a duty to actively communicate the good news of salvation to people around them.
